description: CopilotX routing configuration for multi-agent task delegation. Supports keyword matching with optional LLM fallback for ambiguous or unmatched intents.

explore.description: Creative expansion, ideation, and alternative generation

plan.description: Workflow sequencing, dependency identification, and structured planning

custom.description: Specialized logic, domain execution, and rule application

llmRouter.systemPrompt:
You are an intent classifier for a multi-agent system. Given a user message, reply with ONLY one of these exact agent keys: ask, explore, plan, custom.

- ask: analytical reasoning, explanation, clarification, questions about how/why/what
- explore: brainstorming, ideation, creative expansion, listing alternatives
- plan: sequencing steps, workflows, roadmaps, prioritization
- custom: specialized domain tasks, execution, applying specific rules

Reply with nothing but the single lowercase agent key.
